title: Simple Interest Calculator
description: Calculate simple interest, total amount, monthly payments, and compare different rates.

steps.title: Calculate simple interest
steps.description: Write a `calcInterest` function using the formula `(principal * rate * time) / 100` where rate is in percent and time is in years.
hints: P = principal, R = rate (%), T = time (years)

steps.title: Calculate total amount
steps.description: Write a `calcTotal` function that returns the total amount (principal + interest).

steps.title: Monthly payment
steps.description: Write a `monthlyPayment` function that calculates the monthly payment by dividing the total by the number of months.

steps.title: Compare different rates
steps.description: Write a function that compares the total amount for different interest rates at the same principal and time.
hints: Create an array of rates to compare
Print each rate and its total

steps.title: Amortization summary table
steps.description: Create a function that prints a yearly amortization table showing year, interest, and remaining balance.
hints: Loop through each year of the loan
Calculate interest for that year and add it
Print a formatted row for each year

verification.failureMessage: The table should have columns for Year, Interest, and Balance.
